page.layout: One printed page: running head at top right, one main text column with a marginal note in the right margin, and a catchword and signature at the foot. The left edge of the facing page is visible but cropped, so it is not transcribed.

main_text.head: Explicatio,
main_text.p: A. C. 548 Ostrivog Rex Sclavo-rum cum sua gente occupavit Illyricum, cujus Nepos Seli, expugnata Scodra, Regem Dalmatiæ se appella-vit. Hujus regni tanta fuerunt in-crementa, ut tandem Stephanus circa A. C. 1340 Imperatorem Græciæ, Serviæ & Bulgariæ sese appellaverit. Sed paulo post circa A C. 1460 omnia hæc regna in potestatem Turcarum concesserunt.
main_text.head: SARMATICA,
Canon.
main_text.p: Sarmatica est vel Bohemica, vel Polonica, vel Rusica.
main_text.head: Explicatio:
main_text.p: Salimin Dalmatiæ Rex tres fratres habuit: Czechium, Lechum, & Rusum, qui colonias Sclavorum & Illyricorum circa A. C. 1550 in Bohemiam, Moraviam, Poloniam & Rusiam duxerunt.

page.notes: Right margin note: "z. Sarma-tica." beside the heading SARMATICA. "Ostrivog" is doubtful (the scan shows a crowded letter), marked in the text as printed without [?]; reading uncertain. "Rusum" and "Rusica" transcribed with plain s for long s, as the rule requires. The catchword "BO-" and the signature "D 5" stand at the right on the last text line, not part of the paragraph.
